entries.question: How do I place an order?
entries.answer: Choose a plan on the Order page, enter your details, and follow the invoice instructions. Pay the exact amount on the specified network, and keep your order reference.

entries.question: How do I pay?
entries.answer: New orders accept Bitcoin on mainnet only. Scan your invoice QR or send its exact BTC amount to the address shown before the 15-minute price lock expires. The invoice tracks confirmations. No card details, private keys, or seed phrases are needed.

entries.question: Why must I send the exact quoted amount?
entries.answer: Each invoice carries a unique quoted amount for its asset and network — that is how your payment is matched to your order automatically. Send exactly what the invoice shows, on the network it shows, before the 15-minute price lock expires. Never substitute a rounded amount.

entries.question: How do I check my order or license status?
entries.answer: Use Track an order with your order reference, or reopen your invoice link. I can't see private order or payment details here. If you're stuck, contact support with your order reference.
